note: On the southeast shore of Clear Lake at the edge of the town of Clear Lake. The loops sit in open oak woods about 120 m east of the shore, behind South Shore Drive and a wooded strip; the 900-ft sand beach and the day-use lodge are nearby. The South Loop is closed for the rest of the 2026 season for fire-ring pad installation (sites 1-108 stay open until December 1; ReserveAmerica notice of 2026-11-02). --Claude
summary: Sites -> 148 (131 electric, 12 full hookup, 5 non-electric 26-30 ft), max 109 ft, 97 pull-throughs. Confirmed 50-amp/water/sewer, showers/flush toilets/two dump stations, 100% reservable on ReserveAmerica with a 3-month window and 10 pm day-of cutoff. Season (manual, Apr 1 - Nov 30) matches RA ('Open through Mon Nov 30 2026'). Fees left as recorded (DNR sheet; $12 base is the non-electric sites, which fit 26-30 ft). Not waterfront confirmed: nearest pads (34, 41) ~120 m from the shore through woods with South Shore Drive between; RA has no Proximity to Water attribute here and the site photos of 29-43 show no lake. Pin ~230 m west of the 148-site centroid 43.11052,-93.39160 (inside the limit).
